title: Sil Vantorre
text:
Sil Vantorre. I invest in developer infrastructure at Foundry Seed and I have been doing it long enough to have opinions I am embarrassed by.

I led the Foundry Seed 2019 fund and I still sit on four of its boards, including Quarrystone Labs. The 2019 vintage was small on purpose: twenty-two million dollars, eighteen companies, and no follow-on reserve worth the name.

I live in Austin and I work remotely most weeks, which for an investor mostly means I do not make anyone drive to an office to be told no.

What I want to see: teams who ship to engineers, know what their tool costs to run, and can explain the second-order effects of their own pricing.

What I am tired of: a slide about culture before a slide about the product.
